functions.name: count_if
functions.spark_sql:
WITH input AS (
    SELECT id, id % 3 AS bucket,
        CASE id % 3 WHEN 0 THEN id % 5 = 1 WHEN 1 THEN false ELSE CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) END AS flag
    FROM bench WHERE id < 30
)
SELECT bucket AS id, COUNT_IF(flag) AS value,
    COUNT_IF(DISTINCT flag) AS distinct_value,
    COUNT_IF(flag) FILTER (WHERE id % 2 = 0) AS filtered
FROM input GROUP BY bucket
